thread:
Rina: Spinning up a small canary for acrobat11b-int4 on the bench cluster. Aim: validate mem stability and perf w/ quant mapping change. Starting config: batch=1, max_new_tokens=320, prefetch=off.
Theo: Add trace id ?trace=acrobat-canary-a so we can map kernel decisions.
Rina: Done. First two runs OK but third failed with OOM during generation step ~120.
Jun: Paste of error from node-07:
``
CUDA OOM: allocation failed for 384 MiB. GPU total 40 GiB, used 39.1 GiB, free fragmented.
  at device_alloc.cpp:alloc_chunk
  at kv_cache.cpp:reserve_slot
```
Jun: Looks like fragmentation rather than steady leak. Small frees scattered across arena.
Priya: Are clients sending very long prompts? max_new_tokens 320 plus long context can push sequence len into gemm fallback and spike scratch.
Rina: Yep one request had context 2900 tokens -> total ~3220. Kernel chose fallback path and allocs spiked.
Theo: Quick mitigations: 1) reduce canary default max_new_tokens to 192; 2) set soft_cap: if context+requested > 2048, clamp to 128; 3) enable slot_compactor run every 45s.
Priya: Also try enabling small prefetch window (prefetch=on with window=64) to stabilize allocation patterns for int4. In some rigs that reduced scatter.
Jun: I'll run mem-prof on node-07 and collect allocation heatmap + free-list fragmentation stats. If we see many short-lived tensors, consider transient_reserve=384MiB to coalesce free ranges.
Rina: Plan: apply defaults change now (192), compactor=45s, prefetch window off->on for canary only. Then repro with 10 long prompts.
ops-bot: Canary deployed to bench-2 (nodes: b2-07,b2-09). Monitoring: p50_latency=230ms, mem.free=900MiB, errors=1 OOM.
Theo: Also schedule quality evals at 192 vs 320 to ensure quantization+clamp doesn't hurt outputs. If BLEU/QA delta >2% we consider per-layer re-quant or rollback.
Priya: If fragmentation persists after compactor+reserve, we can try small-batch prefetch combined with early_kv_eviction threshold 0.8 to free old prefixes aggressively.
Rina: Patches pushed for canary. Repro run queued. Jun will post mem-prof output in ~30m.
Jun: Got mem heatmap: lots of 8-32KiB temporaries around generation kernel. Heap shows many non-contiguous frees. Adding transient_reserve improved contiguous free by ~40% in synthetic run.
Rina: Good. Will enable transient_reserve=384MiB for canary and re-run.
Theo: Note for runbook: add step for soft max_new_tokens cap and transient reserve for int4 models on benches.
Rina: Thanks team — will update after the full eval. :thumbsup:
